title: Mary Had a Little Lamb 🎶 #shorts #nurseryrhymes
description:
Sing along with us! 🎶

Lyrics :
Mary had a little lamb,
little lamb, little lamb,
Mary had a little lamb, its
fleece was white as snow.

Everywhere that Mary went,
Mary went, Mary went,
Everywhere that Mary went, the
lamb was sure to go.
